title: iPhone Duo goes on sale — Apple's first foldable, supply-capped, six days before the est. FQ4 print
source: IR: apple.com/newsroom/2026/09/apple-unveils-iphone-duo/, re-fetched direct 2026-09-23 by this event's own initial research — the independent second look this lane's no-self-confirm limit requires (the id was discovered and filed `estimate` on 2026-09-10 by the aapl-iphone-18-launch-2026-09-09 close-out, a sibling lane, off the same page). States verbatim: "Customers in more than 70 countries and regions... will be able to pre-order iPhone Duo beginning at 5 a.m. PT on Friday, October 16, with availability beginning Friday, October 23. iPhone Duo will be available in 28 other countries and regions beginning Friday, October 30." Pricing corroborated on the same page: "starts at $1,999 (U.S.)... in 256GB, 512GB, 1TB, and 2TB storage capacities."
notes: Canonical file written 2026-09-23 from proposals/aapl-iphone-duo-launch-2026-10-23.from-aapl-iphone-18-launch-2026-09-09.json, read in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md's 'when your own event was proposed by others'.
